create_simulationresult: create a simulationresult instance with finish time, proportion completed, energy remaining, and velocity profile
get_finish_time: get the finish time from a simulationresult instance
get_energy_remaining: get the energy remaining list from a simulationresult instance
get_proportion_completed: get the proportion of race completed from a simulationresult instance
to_string: convert a simulationresult to a formatted string showing finish time and cyclist energy remaining
